parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ConnectionTrackingConfiguration
parameters.description: The network connectivity tracking configuration of the ENI.

parameters.name: DeleteOnRelease
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retain the ENI when the associated instance is released. Valid values:

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the network interface controller (NIC). The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: EnhancedNetwork
parameters.description: > This parameter is not publicly available.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

parameters.name: Ipv4Prefix
parameters.description: One or more IPv4 prefixes to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv4PrefixCount
parameters.description: The number of IPv4 prefixes to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: One or more IPv6 addresses to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). You can specify up to 10 IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
parameters.description: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6Prefix
parameters.description: One or more IPv6 prefixes to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6PrefixCount
parameters.description: The number of IPv6 prefixes to assign to the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceName
parameters.description: The name of the network interface controller (NIC). The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters in the Unicode letter categorization (including English and Chinese characters) and ASCII digits (0-9). The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceTrafficConfig
parameters.description: The communication parameter set of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode
parameters.description: The communication mode of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

parameters.name: PrimaryIpAddress
parameters.description: The primary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: One or more secondary private IP addresses selected from the idle IP addresses within the CIDR block of the vSwitch to which the network interface controller (NIC) belongs. Valid values of N: 0 to 10.

parameters.name: QueueNumber
parameters.description: The number of queues for the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values: 1 to 2048.

parameters.name: QueuePairNumber
parameters.description: The number of queues for the RDMA ENI.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network interface controller (NIC) to be created. You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. You can call [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) to query resource group information.

parameters.name: RxQueueSize
parameters.description: The inbound queue depth of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount
parameters.description: The number of private IP addresses for automatic creation by ECS. Valid values: 1 to 49.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the network interface controller (NIC) is added. The security group and the network interface controller (NIC) must belong to the same VPC.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of one or more security groups to which the network interface controller (NIC) is added. The security groups and the network interface controller (NIC) must belong to the same VPC. The valid values of N depend on the quota for the maximum number of security groups to which an ENI can be added. For more information, see [Limits](~~25412~~).

parameters.name: SourceDestCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable source/destination checking. We recommend that you enable this feature to improve network security. Valid values:

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the network interface controller (NIC).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag for the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag for the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TxQueueSize
parameters.description: The outbound queue depth of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the network interface controller (NIC). The private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC) is allocated from the idle IP addresses within the CIDR block of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated.
